item.title: ai: Introducing the Microsoft Copilot harness in Foundry Agent Service
item.description:
Microsoft Foundry is introducing the Microsoft Copilot harness in Foundry Agent Service as part of a shared execution foundation for agent experiences. It is meant to combine context, tools, execution environment, controls, and an agent loop, while preserving customer choice in supported options.

  • Source: Microsoft AI Foundry Blog

item.title: ai: Control where your hosted agent connects with network egress in Foundry Agent Service
item.description:
Microsoft Foundry Agent Service now supports outbound network egress controls for hosted agents. You can define and attach an outbound policy, then monitor allowed and denied calls in Audit or Enforced mode.

  • Source: Microsoft AI Foundry Blog
